title: 第十五章 还有谁第十六章 突变
content_zh:
不过，细想了下，不论自家弟弟天赋如何了得，就他那耿直的脾气，顶多适合做一族之长。而弟弟所觉醒的血脉之力，又正好是母亲家族帝堃李家的血脉之力，若是与弟弟交好，日后将他扶上李家家主之位，倒是一个有力的后援。
在魔族子弟露出挑衅的笑容，想要向李剑锋动手时，赵镇麓突然道，“等等，我还有两句话要说。”
非鱼不屑道，“妇人之见。”
“镇峰，你我血脉相连，今日就听大哥一声，这件事由大哥处理。”停顿了下，赵镇麓继续道，“镇峰，我不知道，你是如何获得兽血丹的。若是你现在愿意听大哥的安排，不仅是你可以得到相应的兽血丹，你那些部下也都可以得到兽血丹。虽然这些兽血丹来之不易，但是大哥可以给你，而有了这些兽血丹，你的那些部下就再也不用担心受到大阵的排斥了。”
赵镇麓会在态度上有所改变，正是因为李剑锋暴露了自身的血脉实力，功利心之重再明显不过了。而这也算是赵镇麓做出最大的让步。
李剑锋坚定道，“大哥，你的好意，我心领了。今日我会与武兄共进退，我绝不会食言。”
身为堃国皇族中的一员，李剑锋能够有如此性情，倒真是令人意外。
这个时候，进入武书神识之中的碑灵小灵，在亲身感受到封印在武书体内的精神之力后，小灵是彻底想要跪在武书身前了。小灵是真的不敢相信，在厚土大陆上的这些炼体怪中，竟还存在拥有这般强大精神力的人，而且还如此年轻。
当然了，这说跪就跪。
武书并没有召唤小灵，小灵是直接现身，巴掌大小的石碑是最大程度的弯着腰，贴附在武书大腿上道，“老大，请收下小弟的膝盖。日后，不论老大有任何吩咐，小灵都将为老大赴汤蹈火以赴犬马之劳。”
这突如其来的一幕，真的是惊呆了众人。武书都感觉莫名其妙，在他没有召唤小灵的情况下，小灵竟然自己跑出来了，出来也就算了，还口吐人言。这不是在告诉众人，他就是宝贝吗？
“老大，这些小崽子都是垃圾，你别怕。看来，今天必须让老大见识见识小灵的能力了，横扫一切的绝对实力。”
碑灵小灵这般献殷勤，无非是认识到了武书精神力的强大，现在它想要拿出点实力表个忠心。而对于小灵这头脑简单的性格，也是让武书觉得有意思的。小家伙，说不好是个战斗狂呢？
在武书想要知道小灵拥有何种惊人实力时，小灵就是出现在武书手中，如板砖大小，继续道，“老大，我这个自创技能，名为板砖拍。老大，你可千万别小看这个名字，名字听着是土了点，但却是在某日小灵一个灵光乍现才想到这个名字的。”
武左武右就算是话痨了，这小灵在这方面的天赋，似乎还要略胜武左武右。
而在武书还在心里叹息时，小灵铿锵有力道，“老大，我这招板砖拍，在出手时，一定要有气势，我现在就给你演示一下。”
小灵话音一落就是冲向近处的魔族子弟，同时小灵的声音响彻全场，“尔等魔族宵小，竟敢觊觎我家老大的宝贝小灵我，今日若是不让尔等长长记性，我小灵就不姓武。”
小灵的声音在广场上回荡，在众人都觉得反应出现迟钝时，小灵怒道，“魔族小崽子，吃我一板砖。”
紧接着就听啪一声，非鱼命来取碑石的魔族小子直接被小灵抽飞出去，搬砖大小的红印也是留在他的脸上。
魔族天生拥有强大的身体，就这么被碑石抽风，足可见小灵自身实力也不弱。

“还有谁？”
将人抽飞后，在众人还没反应过来时，小灵又是怒吼一声。
再看向小灵时，武书只觉得，小灵这装逼套路很深啊？撇开话痨这个身份，这货的行事风格倒很符合武书的胃口。
小灵所表现出的实力，的确不容小觑，非鱼都是因小灵的出手眉头紧蹙。一时间倒是没有人再敢叫嚣，要与武书决斗，抢夺武书什么的。很满意众人的表现，小灵又是回到武书面前，一副很骄傲的道，“老大，怎么样？我这招板砖拍，威慑力足够猛吗？”
小灵刚才的出手，利用了精神力攻击，压制了对手的反应，的确是有点实力的。武书很满意道，“小灵，可以啊？还懂得精神攻击，很不错，作为兵器很趁手，我决定了，这以后，你就是我武书的第一件趁手兵器了。”
小灵高兴道，“真的吗？老大，我竟然是你的第一件趁手兵器，老大你太会说话了，小灵真的太崇拜你了。”
content_en:
However, after thinking about it carefully, no matter how talented my younger brother is, with his upright temper, he is at most suitable to be the leader of the clan. And the blood power awakened by his younger brother happens to be the blood power of his mother's family, the Emperor Kun Li. If he has a good relationship with his younger brother, it will be a powerful support for him to become the head of the Li family in the future.
When the demon disciple showed a provocative smile and wanted to attack Li Jianfeng, Zhao Zhenlu suddenly said, "Wait, I have two more words to say."
Feiyu said disdainfully, "A woman's opinion."
"Zhenfeng, you and I are connected by blood. Today, I will listen to my eldest brother and let him handle this matter." After a pause, Zhao Zhenlu continued, "Zhenfeng, I don't know how you obtained the beast blood pill. If you are willing to listen to eldest brother's arrangements now, not only will you You can get the corresponding beast blood pills, and your subordinates can also get the beast blood pills. Although these beast blood pills are hard to come by, big brother can give them to you, and with these beast blood pills, your subordinates no longer have to worry about being rejected by the formation. "
Zhao Zhenlu changed his attitude precisely because Li Jianfeng exposed his bloodline strength, and his utilitarianism couldn't be more obvious. And this can be regarded as the biggest concession Zhao Zhenlu has made.
Li Jianfeng said firmly, "Brother, I appreciate your kindness. I will advance and retreat together with Brother Wu today, and I will never break my promise."
As a member of the Kun Kingdom royal family, it is really surprising that Li Jianfeng has such a temperament.
At this time, Xiaoling, the tablet spirit who entered Wushu's spiritual consciousness, felt the power of the spirit sealed in Wushu's body. Xiaoling wanted to kneel in front of Wushu. Xiao Ling really couldn't believe that among these body-refining monsters on the thick earth continent, there were still people with such strong spiritual power, and they were still so young.
Of course, if you say kneel down, kneel down.
Wu Shu did not summon Xiao Ling. Xiao Ling showed up directly. The palm-sized stone tablet was bent as much as possible and attached to Wu Shu's thigh, saying, "Boss, please accept my knee. In the future, no matter what the boss orders, Xiao Ling will go through fire and water for the boss."
This sudden scene really shocked everyone. Wu Shu felt inexplicable. When he didn't summon Xiao Ling, Xiao Ling actually ran out on his own. He didn't care about coming out and kept talking. Doesn't this tell everyone that he is the treasure?
"Boss, these little brats are rubbish, don't be afraid. It seems that today we must let the boss see Xiao Ling's ability, the absolute strength to sweep everything."
The small spirit of the stele spirit is so attentive because it realizes the power of Wu Shu's spiritual power, and now it wants to show its loyalty with some strength. Wu Shu also found Xiao Ling's simple-minded character interesting. Little guy, maybe he is a fighting maniac?
When Wu Shu wanted to know what kind of amazing strength Xiao Ling had, Xiao Ling appeared in Wu Shu's hand, as big as a brick, and continued, "Boss, my self-created skill is called Brick Pai. Boss, please don't underestimate this name. It sounds a bit unsophisticated, but Xiao Ling came up with this name one day when he suddenly had an idea."
Even though Wu Zuo and Wu You are talkative, this little spirit seems to be slightly more talented in this area than Wu Zuo and Wu You.
While Wu Shu was still sighing in his heart, Xiao Ling said loudly and forcefully, "Boss, when I shoot this move, I must have momentum when I take action. I will demonstrate it to you now."
As soon as Xiao Ling finished speaking, he rushed towards the demon disciples who were nearby. At the same time, Xiao Ling's voice resounded throughout the entire audience, "How dare you, Xiao Ling, to covet my eldest son's precious son, Xiao Ling. If I don't let you and others have a long memory today, my surname, Xiao Ling, will not be Wu."
Xiao Ling's voice echoed in the square. When everyone felt that their reactions were slow, Xiao Ling said angrily, "You little devil, eat a brick from me."
Then I heard a bangWith a loud sound, the demon kid who came to take the stele without Yu's life was whipped away by Xiao Ling, and a red mark the size of a brick was left on his face.
The demons are born with a powerful body, and to be stunned by the stone like this shows that Xiao Ling's own strength is not weak.
"Who else?"
After whipping the person away, before anyone could react, Xiao Ling roared again.
When he looked at Xiao Ling again, Wu Shu only felt that Xiao Ling's pretentiousness was very deep, wasn't it? Putting aside his status as a talkative, this guy's behavior is very much in line with Wu Shu's taste.
The strength shown by Xiao Ling should not be underestimated. Feiyu frowned because of Xiao Ling's action. For a while, no one dared to clamor for a duel with Wu Shu or to snatch Wu Shu or anything like that. Satisfied with everyone's performance, Xiao Ling returned to the martial arts book and said proudly, "Boss, how are you? Is my move powerful enough to intimidate you?"
Xiao Ling's attack just now used mental power to attack and suppress the opponent's reaction. It was indeed quite powerful. Wu Shu said with satisfaction, "Xiao Ling, is that okay? You also know how to attack mentally, which is very good. It is very useful as a weapon. I have decided that from now on, you will be my first weapon in Wu Shu."
Xiao Ling said happily, "Really? Boss, I am your first weapon. Boss, you are so good at talking. Xiao Ling really admires you."
